predictor.notes: Best-supported model: a constant minimum through quantity 151, linear pricing from 152 through 543, then a 12% reduction of that linear formula from 544 onward. Matches all 96 successful responses across 94 distinct quantities, including the approved results at 50 and 200; all responses reported roundingCents=0. Both transitions were checked at adjacent quantities (151/152 and 543/544), with additional rounding-sensitive validation in the final segment. Unobserved quantities are predictions, not measurements; narrow additional bands or other unsampled deviations cannot be excluded. Used 96 business requests and 9 REA operations including inspection.
